threat_event: SSI from designated clients and Gas Transmission is disclosed from the IDP or engineering shares
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SSI marking or need-to-know groups
treatment_plan: SSI program and separate SSI store (POAM-019)

threat_event: Integrity engineers' access is abused to pivot into group OT
threat_source: Attacker using a stolen engineer account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing historian replica read access; gateway access for client and group work
treatment_plan: Remove standing access; request per project (POAM-021)

threat_event: An OT assessment toolkit holding client network captures is lost or stolen
treatment_plan: Enforced deletion 30 days after close; evidence store only (POAM-020)

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts engineering file shares and steals client CEII and SSI
treatment_plan: Move client SSI and CEII to the SSI store (POAM-019)

threat_event: A tenant isolation defect exposes one client's integrity data to another
The ILI anomaly classification model misclassifies a severe anomaly and a client delays a repair
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model used in client deliverables without disclosure or documented validation by anomaly type
treatment_plan: Validation by anomaly type; disclosure to clients (P10)

threat_event: A 72-hour client notice or an SSI disclosure report to TSA is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No register of client notice terms; SSI reporting not in procedures
treatment_plan: Client notice register; SSI reporting step (POAM-005)

threat_event: The division is liable as an authorized representative under a client's TSA directive without contract terms that define its duties
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Client contracts do not name the SD measures performed or the liability

threat_event: An IDP subservice provider has an outage or breach that the division does not see in time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Subservice providers reviewed once a year

threat_event: SOC 2 Type 2 exceptions cost client contracts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: First Type 2 period in progress; gaps found in readiness (P09)
treatment_plan: Close readiness gaps before period end (P09)

threat_event: The IDP is unavailable when clients need records for a pressure reduction decision
The report drafting assistant leaks client data or inserts errors into reports
CEII received from clients is handled outside NDA terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CEII stored with ordinary project files
treatment_plan: Store with SSI under the same rules

threat_event: An ILI vendor delivers data files carrying malware
A departing consultant keeps client data on a personal device
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Personal devices blocked from SYS-E1 but not from the productivity suite on the web

threat_event: A client user account on the IDP is taken over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Clients not federated use IDP accounts; MFA optional for 23 clients
treatment_plan: Require MFA for all client users by 2027-03-31

threat_event: The OT Assessment Practice assesses a group division and its independence is challenged
existing_controls: Policy: the practice does not assess group divisions for TSA purposes
treatment_plan: Avoided by policy (POL-01 4.9); outside firm used for the Transmission architecture design review
